div.p: This Contract is made between the Company and the Client for the purpose of CERTIFICATION of the Client.

In order to initiate this contract 100% advance i.e., USD
only of the initial audit fee shall be taken. For surveillance audits it will be payable before every surveillance audit visit and must be settled before the audit activity at site.
Please note that the Advance Fee is Non-Refundable.
* No. of Man-Days are proposed and may require adjustment as per final approval of MD Calculation.
div.div: The Client hereby undertakes and vows:

ol.li: To comply at all times with the provision of the rules of the Company (TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd.) and its sister companies i.e. TUV AUSTRIA HELLAS and TUV AUSTRIA CERT GMBH.

To pay all fees and charges connected with the Stage 1 & Stage 2 assessment process, Certification, Surveillance & Re-certification Audit Process irrespective of whether the Client’s Company passes the audit, or not, and a certificate is, or not, granted or maintained.
Both parties shall give a prior notice of three (3) months in case of cancellation of contract along with a cogent reason.

The Client hereby undertakes to accept the surveillance audit execution date, as per the frequency mentioned on page 1 i.e., within fifteen days of notification from the Company. In case the client fails to comply with the CB rules & regulations of the Company and fails to have the surveillance audit conducted within twelve (12) months after the initial audit conducted, then Certification will be suspended and may be further withdrawn (cancelled), e.g., if the initial audit is conducted on May 20, 2024, then the surveillance audit will be due and conducted before or on May 19, 2025. Please note in case of suspension additional man-days shall be applicable for reinstatement and lifting of suspension. In case of cancellation new audit activity shall take place. In either case additional man-day charges shall be invoiced to the client.

In case the client is in breach of clause no. 4 of this contract, the Issued Certificate will be suspended/cancelled. A suspension letter would be sent by the Scheme Manager / Certification & Controlling Manager, which would specify timeframe to take actions to avoid cancellation. Any such cancellation may be published in the newspaper and updated on TUV Austria website and IAF Portal and a copy may be forwarded to accreditation bodies, relevant ministries and chambers of commerce.

The Client shall facilitate a witness audit if requested by the Company’s Accreditation Body. Such witness audit is observed against the working of the CB and does not in any manner concerns the Client’s activities or system.
TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd. can conduct the unannounced audits as part of surveillance activities where required as per applicable standards.
All payments will be made in advance or before the start of the audit activity through cross cheque/DD/P.O. payable to “TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd.” only.

All payments shall be strictly and only made in favor of the Company through Cross Cheque/DD/PO only. It is advised to the Client that under no circumstances they should make payment in cash or bank transfer to any other party, person or company other than TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd. Failing to comply with this clause will give TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd. the right to claim any payment from the Client which has not been realized by TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd.

In view of provision referred in clause (b) of sub-section (1) of section 153 read with sub-section (4A) of section 153 and clause (94) of part- IV of second schedule of the Income Tax Ordinance 2001. TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd., is subject to 6% WHT deduction as referred u/s 153 (1) (b) of Income Tax Ordinance 2001. This percentage may change time to time as per government regulation. Therefore, while making payment you shall deduct 6% WHT on invoice amount.
The certificate issued remains the property of TUV AUSTRIA BUREAU OF INSPECTION & CERTIFICATION (PVT.) LTD. to whom it must be returned on request.

In case of verification of correction of a major non-conformance additional amount of USD. 80/- will be charged for each man-day. In case of minor non-conformance, no additional amount will be charged.
This contract is valid for 3 years which includes Initial Audit activity and minimum 2 surveillance audits during the 3 years of certification cycle.
For any cheque that is bounced / not honored Rs. 750/- will be charged from the client.
The above price of the services provided are net off any Government taxes i.e. Sales Tax, VAT, Duties etc. These will be borne by the Client levied if any thereafter.
Client cannot challenge the services rendered by the Company or the result of the audit in any court of law.
Certificates will be issued within 4-6 weeks after successful completion of the audits and closure of NCRs.

Neither Party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations under this Agreement if such failure or delay is due to causes beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to acts of God, natural disasters, war, terrorism, civil unrest, labor strikes, epidemic or pandemic, government actions, or failures of suppliers or subcontractors due to any such cause (each a “Force Majeure Event”). The affected Party shall notify the other Party promptly, within five (5) working days of the occurrence of a Force Majeure Event, and shall use reasonable efforts to mitigate the impact and resume performance as soon as possible. If the Force Majeure Event continues for more than thirty (30) days, either Party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice to the other.
Annually Client shall be charged 5% as inflation charge.

Use of Certification Logo/Marks & Accreditation Marks
The Client understands that the Certification Logo/Marks and Accreditation Marks are the property of TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection & Certification (Pvt.) Ltd. and the
respectively.
The Client has thoroughly read Annexure 1: Use of Certification and Accreditation Marks and will ensure full compliance, only where applicable.
Any deviation from the Use of Certification Logo/Marks and Accreditation Marks Policy shall result in cancellation of the Certificate(s).

Each Party acknowledges and agrees that the confidential information received by it from the other Party shall be kept strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed or revealed to any other person other than those employees of such party who needs to know the confidential information for the purpose of performing their respective obligations under this Agreement and such employees shall take appropriate steps to keep secret all information provided to them. The obligations of the Company under this article shall remain valid and in full force even after termination of this Agreement, maximum up to two (02) years after termination. However, the Company shall not be held liable or responsible for the information already in the public knowledge. For the purposes of this article the confidential information shall include but not limited to the information pertaining to the business and operations of
and information relating to its audit result, charges, accreditation details etc. etc.

div.p: In case of any conflict between TUV AUSTRIA BUREAU OF INSPECTION & CERTIFICATION (PVT.) LTD. Pakistan and the Client, TUV Austria Vienna shall assume the role of the arbitrator and the verdict of the TUV Austria Global DIRECTOR shall be deemed as final.

t.div: Annexure 1: Use of Certification Logo/Mark and Accreditation Marks Policy
Duration of the Right of Use

ol.li: The issue of the certificate authorizes the customer to hold the certificate and use the certification Logo/Mark.
The right to hold the certificate and use the certification logo/mark ends with the end of the contractual relationship.

t.div: Scope of the Right of Use

ol.li: The customer should not use the certificate and the certification logo/mark in a misleading manner, rather they are always to be used in such a way that only inferences can be drawn from the issued certification, especially by third parties.

The approval to hold the certificate and use the certification logo/mark applies exclusively to the certified area of the customer’s company in direct connection with the company name or employer’s name or the company logo of the customer. Usage of the certificate and the certification logo/mark for another - uncertified - area of the customer is PROHIBITTED! The area is determined by the certification body’s scope of work.

The customer can use the certificate and/or the certification logo/mark for business purposes on business correspondence documents (e.g., letterheads, visiting cards, e-mail etc. etc.) and for advertisement purposes (e.g., company vehicles, website, brochures etc. etc.) in the specified form. They can be used in any size while STRICTLY maintaining the proportions. The certificate and the certification logo/mark should be easily readable and clearly visible. The usage should be such that neither the certification body nor the certification system is discredited or public trust in the certification is imperiled.

The certificate and the certification logo/mark MUST NOT be used on products or product packaging or even in connection with the products in any way or manner which gives the impression that the product(s) itself/themselves are certified.

The customer is obliged to inform the certification body beforehand in writing about any proposed usage of the certificate and the certification logo/mark and obtain a special usage approval for the particular case.

t.div: Suspension of the Right of use

ol.li:
The right of the customer to hold the certificate and use the certification logo/mark is suspended by the certification body with immediate effect, if
The certificate and/or the certification logo/mark are misused by the customer, especially if any of the regulations concerning the scope of right of use are violated,
The result of the surveillance audit does not vindicate the validity of the certification,
Surveillance audits are not carried out due to reasons outside the control of the certification body,
The certification is suspended according to the regulations of the certification body,
The customer does not receive any approval or if the certification body issues a request - even without justification - to temporarily desist from holding the certification logo/mark and/or the certificate.

The customer is obliged to immediately desist from holding the certificate in case of suspension of the right of use by the certification body. Existing documents, media etc. etc., which are endowed with the certificate or the certification logo/mark, can be used by the customer for a maximum of one month from the time of suspension of the certification.
The suspension can be revoked by the certification body again depending on the implementation of verified correction measures

t.div: Termination of the right of use

ol.li:
The right of the customer to hold the certificate and use the certification Logo/Mark ends with immediate effect, if
the validity of the certificate has expired,
the certification is revoked according to the regulations of the certification body,
the contractual relationship (due to whichever reasons) has ended,
the customer receives a request from the certification body - even without justification - to temporarily desist from holding the certification logo/mark and/or the certificate.
The customer is obliged to immediately desist from holding the certificate and using the certification logo/mark in case the right of use is terminated by the certification body

t.p: These rules and regulations define the requirements for use of logo and certification mark. Purpose of this document is to clarify the requirements on use of PNAC logo (accreditation mark) as per the guidance document of PNAC (Pakistan National Accreditation Council). All certified organizations (clients) of TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection and Certification (Pvt.) Ltd. with PNAC accreditation logo are required to ensure that:

ol.li: The use of the mark shall be strictly limited to the certification scope of the certified organization as approved by TUV Austria Bureau of Inspection and Certification (Pvt.) Ltd.
The mark (as below) shall be displayed only in combination with the certification body's logo.

When a Laboratory’s quality or environment system is certified, it shall not enable the laboratory to use PNAC’s logo / mark on testing and inspection reports or calibration certificates or in any manner which implies these activities are accredited by PNAC.
The certified organization shall not give impression of any accredited product certification. The certified organization shall not affix the PNAC mark on the products or any of their packaging.
Further details on use of PNAC Logo can be downloaded from PNAC official web site. www.pnac.gov.pk

t.div: Certified companies can use the mark on:

ol.li: Letters and other documents; the accreditation mark is to be no more conspicuous than the TUV logo.
Business cards.
Website

t.div: Certified companies cannot use the mark on:

ol.li: Reports and certificates from certified calibration and testing laboratories and inspection bodies.
Products or their packages.
Vehicles.

t.p: The certified company should not make claims or declarations that are not true or give the impression that the company, parts of the company or its subsidiaries and associates are certificated for activities or services when they are not.
The logos, marks, claims or declarations should not be used in a way as to imply that TUV or PNAC accepts responsibilities for activities carried out under the scope of the certification.
